scope: Holy Paladin heal sims: two base requests (the default healer gear on the 38/13 Holy talents with Holy Light, Flash of Light, Holy Shock and Divine Favor cast on the player at 180 seconds, and the 33/15 talents with Greater Blessing of Light at 300 seconds, out of mana), 60 randomized variants of each at 200 iterations drawing Human, Dwarf or Undead, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust. Healing is counted in full on the player, as Go reports it, so HPS, time out of mana, Illumination's mana and the first-fight log are compared.
generator: python3 tools/sweep.py --seed 20261021 --count 60 --iterations 200 --races RaceHuman,RaceDwarf,RaceUndead --output <scratch>/NAME validation/2026-10-21-holy-paladin-sweep/NAME.base.json for NAME holy-paladin-healing and holy-paladin-blessing-of-light-oom; each <scratch>/NAME/sweep-NN.json is compared as variants/NAME-sweep-NN.request.json

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: Before the fix in core::fight::healing two variants of the first sweep differed in the last printed digit of a Holy Shock crit (676.267 in Go, 676.268 in Rust): Go fuses baseHealing += BonusCoefficient * HealingPower (spell_result.go:746, FMADDD) and Rust rounded the product first. The heal now uses mul_add, and holy-paladin-fused-bonus-healing keeps one of those fights as a fixture.
